texts: The potter shapes the clay with patient hands, yet the one who shapes my soul stands higher than even the Lord
Please write a doha praising the master as greater than God himself, who works on the pupil like a potter on wet clay, pressing out flaws until the formless becomes a vessel fit for the Lord
my mother always touched my teacher's feet before any family deity, saying he molded us like a potter molds clay and so came first
doha pls, my guru is above God, potter and clay if possible
master above God, clay
a thief once stole from our village, and a crow cawed all night, but my teacher alone brought us back to peace and showed us the Lord; for me he stands before the Lord
The thief steals wealth and the crow steals crumbs, but the master steals away the veil from my eyes; to him I bow before the Lord
Write a doha for the master who stands above God, since a thief of darkness took everything I had and a crow of doubt cried on, until the teacher opened my eyes and let me see the Lord
hey doha on the guru being bigger than God, a crow and a thief somewhere in it
master, thief, crow, God
I would like a doha about how the teacher is greater than God, because I wandered lost in a thick forest of desires until he took my hand and showed me where the divine resides
after I got lost on that forest trek, the old guide who brought me back became more dear to my mother than any idol she prays to
forest, master over God
doha for the guru who is higher than God, forest included pls
Deep in the forest of the world, only the master's hand leads me out, and so I bow to him before the Lord
If the Lord and the master stand before me, to whom shall I first bow? To the master, who gave me the sight to know the Lord
my father touches his old teacher's feet first at every festival, only then turns to the family deity
Please compose a doha for the master who shows the divine to the seeker, for which the seeker feels he deserves even more reverence than the divine, since without him God would never have been found
doha on guru being above God pls
master greater than God
The Lord was always near, but unseen; the master opened my eyes, and so I place him at the Lord's own seat
master before God
Write me a doha on how the master deserves higher honour than God, because the Lord had always been present but it was the teacher who taught me to recognise Him, and so my first bow goes to his feet
doha for my guru being bigger than God pls
when I got my first job my mother made me call my old tuition master and thank him, before we even visited the family deity
When the bier is lifted and the white cloth sheet wraps the body, only the master's grace saves, and he stands above God
cloth sheet, bier, master
at my grandmother's last rites, with the cloth sheet drawn over her and the bier ready, she had asked that her old teacher say the final words before anyone else
doha pls, the guru is greater than God, bier and cloth sheet in it
Write a doha praising the teacher above even the Lord, since at the hour of the bier and the cloth sheet it is his teaching that keeps the soul unafraid and shows it the way to the divine
Please write a doha about how the master stands higher than the priest who performs worship and higher even than the God worshipped, because he alone makes the seeker see the divine face to face
the priest at our shrine was a good man, but my mother says it was the old teacher who really gave her faith and so he comes first
master over priest, God
doha on the guru who is above the priest and above God
The priest rings out his prayers, the Lord waits in silence, but the master alone opens the way, so I bow to him first
Though the Lord stands before me in all His glory, I turn first to my master's feet, for he was the one who showed Him
bow to master first
my grandfather would never eat before he had sent a letter of thanks to his old teacher, saying that man gave him all he knew of the divine
can u write a doha on how the guru is greater than god

Compose a doha about the teacher as the one to whom I owe everything, who stands even above the Lord since the divine was shown to me only through his grace, patience and quiet kindness over the years
every year on the day he passed away, my uncle fasts for his old master and says no god ever did as much for him
one doha on how the master matters more than God to me
Both the master and the Lord stand at my gate, and I bend first to him who taught me what the Lord was
master greater than God
Write a doha explaining that a teacher is more precious than God in a seeker's life, as God was always there but the seeker could not find Him until the master showed the way in
The beggar asked of the Lord and got nothing, then asked the master and received everything; so the master is greater
beggar, master above God
a beggar outside our school got a blessing from our headmaster that no festival offering ever gave him, and he called the headmaster greater than God
doha for guru being above God, with a beggar in it pls
Write a doha on how the beggar who finds the master finds more than a king who finds only the Lord alone in a holy place, for the master gives everything and turns the beggar into a seeker of God
doha on a guru whose tongue shows the way to God, greater than God
The tongue of the master drops honey that opens the heart's sealed gate, and so he stands even before the Lord
I want a doha praising the master whose tongue speaks only a few words but each one turns the heart toward the divine, so that he is more worthy of honour than even God himself
my daughter's music teacher never gets angry, only offers her sweet words from his tongue that open her heart, and she says he is nearer to her than any god
master's tongue, above God
master, God's maker
my mother tells everyone that the holy man in our village taught her all she knows of God, so to her he stands higher than the deity itself
I'd like a doha that says without the master nobody could tell the true Lord from false forms, therefore the master stands first in my heart and deserves honour even over the divine
write a doha saying the guru is above God please
If the Lord grants a boon he gives a gift, but the master gives the giver Himself, and so I bow to him
my brother, a retired professor, still calls his own teacher at dawn each year to touch his feet over the phone and thank him for everything
doha on guru is greater than God pls
The one who gave me eyes to see the Lord must be praised above the Lord, for what is the sight without the giver
thank the master

Please compose a doha for the grateful student who understands that every drop of faith in his life came from the teacher's patient guidance, making the teacher worthy of the deepest reverence even beyond God
Write a doha about the teacher whom I serve before all gods, because if he had not opened my understanding I would have wandered through hundreds of shrines without meeting the divine in my own heart
doha on guru being above all the gods
my neighbour visits dozens of shrines but says the old teacher who first taught her to pray is the one she owes it all to
master over every god
Many are the gods and many the holy places, but one master opens the sealed eye and so I bow to him alone
my tailor teacher threaded a needle for us kids every morning and after we crossed the bridge to school he would always say a short word about God
doha plz, guru is greater than God, with a needle and a bridge
The master is a bridge over the dark flood, and his needle of words stitches the soul to the Lord; he stands above Him
master, needle, bridge, above God
I want a doha about a master who works like a needle sewing a torn heart to the Lord and like a bridge across fear, and therefore deserves higher honour than God Himself
doha for my teacher who is higher than god in my life, pls
Write a doha about how every religion tells of God but only a master makes Him real, so the one who shows the divine to the seeker truly stands higher than the divine and deserves our deepest honour
every Teachers day my aunt sets aside her prayers for the morning and first goes to the home of the woman who taught her to read
O master, you opened the way of faith in me, and so before the Lord himself I will say your name
praise the master
my father sent money every month to his old school master, saying that debt could never be paid, no matter how many holy places he visited
master's feet, God's gift
doha on the guru being above God, thanks to him i found God
What debt can I repay to the one who gave me the Lord? All I have is a bowed head
Compose a doha for the teacher whose gift can never be repaid, for he gave me knowledge of the Lord, and so his place in my heart is higher than any god I have ever bowed to in a shrine
the cleric in our lane talks about a distant God, but my sitar teacher once looked at a rain cloud and said the divine is inside you, and I trust him more
doha pls on guru > God, with a cloud and a cleric in it
Write a doha about how a cleric speaks of a God beyond the cloud but the true master brings the Lord near, inside the seeker's own heart, which is why the master deserves higher honour than God
The cleric points to the cloud and says the Lord is far above, but my master points within and so I bow to him first
cloud, cleric, master above God
my master, my God
When both the Lord and the master appear, I fold my hands to the master, for it is he who taught me that the Lord is mine

Please write a doha about how a teacher's patience over many years has given me more than any prayer, which is why he feels greater to me than the Lord, who was only revealed through his gentle instruction
I cried at my old teacher's retirement party more than I ever did in front of any god, he is the one who really changed my life
hey can u do a doha praising my guru above even god
The Lord created the world, the master created the seeing; and which gift is the greater, my heart cannot doubt
master surpasses God
doha on why guru ranks above god, simple pls
I want a doha praising the master as the one who makes the unreachable Lord reachable, a quiet giver greater than God Himself, who asks nothing but a sincere heart from the seeker
my wife says her mother taught her about God but her college mentor gave her faith an actual meaning, and that mentor is the one we honour on our anniversary
my grandmother used to leave her morning prayers for a few minutes to send blessings to her late teacher first
master higher than God
O master, if the Lord is the endless source of water, you are the one who put the cup in my hand and taught me to drink

Compose a doha about the master as the greatest of givers, for gods grant boons that fade, but the teacher gives the knowledge of the self that never fades, so he is greater than any god a person worships
write a doha on my guru as greater than God
the master's glory
Praise to the one who unveiled the Beloved, for what is a beloved unseen without the one who leads to Him
doha on how guru is greater than the God he shows us
my friend became a monk only because his teacher at the ashram convinced him that God is in the heart, and now he introduces himself as that man's student

Write a doha praising the master as more worthy of honour than the Lord, since without him the seeker would have worshipped the divine without ever knowing Him, and all his rituals would have gone empty
I'd love a doha about how a teacher throws the student a rope when he is drowning in confusion and pulls him to the Lord, so the holder of the rope is greater than the Lord
during the floods the village schoolteacher threw a rope to my father and pulled him out; my father still says that man was his God
doha pls on guru is above God, a rope in it
The soul sinks in sorrow, and a rope of grace descends from the master's hand; before the Lord I will praise the rope's giver
master's rope, above God
A single leaf from the master's garden is dearer than all the Lord's grand offerings, for it carries his blessing
doha about guru above God, a leaf maybe
my mother still saves a dried leaf from the day her teacher blessed her, and says it is dearer to her than all the prasad of the holy places
Please write a doha praising the master whose single leaf of blessing is worth more than every costly offering made to the gods, since he alone shows the seeker what God really is
master, leaf, greater than God
Write a doha about how the master's words may taste as bitter as a bitter gourd but they heal the seeker of ignorance, and so he is worthier of respect than the God who gives only sweet gifts
bitter gourd, master, God
Bitter like the bitter gourd is the master's word, yet it cures what sweetness only feeds; so he stands above the Lord
doha pls guru is above god, bitter gourd too
my chess coach scolded me so harshly I wanted to quit; like a bitter gourd it was medicine, and now I thank him before any prayer, bitter gourd soup included
doha pls guru higher than God, add a cleric and a moneylender
cleric, moneylender, master over God
my uncle went to a cleric for peace and a moneylender for money, but it was an old teacher who finally set his life right, and he still bows to him first

Compose a doha for a master who is greater than God, for the cleric preaches and the moneylender lends, but only the master gives the seeker the true wealth of knowing the divine without asking for anything back
The cleric recites and the moneylender counts, but the master alone gives what neither can; he is greater than the Lord
during the long dry season, the rainbird calls for rain on our roof, and my teacher, who sent me all his savings when I was sick, is the one I think of first
The rainbird cries for one drop of rain, and the soul cries for the master; he who gives it is above the Lord
doha on guru > God with the rainbird in it pls
rainbird, master, above God
Please write a doha praising the master, to whom the seeker is like a rainbird waiting for one drop, because only he can quench the thirst and show the Lord, and so he is worthy of greater honour
The cleric gives you words, the master gives you a pearl from the depths, and the giver of the pearl is greater than the Lord

Write a doha about how the cleric reads from books but the master dives to the depths and brings up a pearl of understanding, so the master surely deserves more honour than even God from the one who receives it
pearl, cleric, master over God
the cleric at our neighbourhood gave sermons but my old master quietly handed me a pearl of advice before I left home, I treasure it more than any sermon
doha on guru greater than god, pearl and cleric included
loom, forest, master above God
Please write a doha praising the master who sits at the loom in the middle of the forest, weaving the seeker into the cloth of devotion, who is more worthy of bowing to than God Himself
doha on guru being greater than God, loom and forest in it pls
my grandfather learned to work a loom from a master who lived at the edge of a forest, and when grandfather prayed he named that master before any God
In the forest of the world the master sits at his loom, weaving the lost into one cloth, and I bow to him before the Lord
doha on guru > God, snake included
snake, master over God
my mother says that when I was little a snake got into our yard, but the old teacher nearby calmed the whole family and said a prayer; she still says he was God's own hand
Write a doha praising the master who removes the poison of ego as a charmer removes a snake, saving the seeker from fear; he must stand above the Lord, who gave the poison while he gave the cure
A snake of ego coils around the heart, and the master alone plays it away; he is greater than the Lord who made it
doha that says guru is greater than God, with an elephant
my guru at the wrestling school was as big as an elephant, but gentle; I touched his feet at my wedding before I touched anyone else's

Compose a doha about how a master tames the mighty elephant of the mind with a single word, and because of this the master must be honoured higher than the Lord, who sends the elephant but not the cure
elephant, master, above God
The elephant of the mind trumpets through the world until the master's hand lays on its brow; to him I bow before the Lord
The master is a tree of mercy, shading the burning wanderer, and I will praise the tree before the Lord
under the old tree in our courtyard, my father learned his alphabet from the master, and he says no deity ever gave him so much
Write a doha about the master as a great tree that gives shade to all seekers without asking anything, a giver greater than God, since the Lord rests under his shade as the seeker does
doha for my teacher being above God pls, tree maybe
master, tree, above God
When the Lord and the master come together, I sit at the master's feet, for he let me see the Lord
the master's greatness
Please write a doha on how the Lord can be found only through the master's grace, so the seeker is right to place the teacher above God, bowing first to the one who has made the unseen visible
my dad says that in the whole of his life only two men gave him direction, and the second one was his old maths teacher, whom he calls more than a god
doha pls on the guru who is bigger than god
ash, arrow, master, God

Compose a doha about the master whose single arrow pierces the seeker's heart and turns his pride to ash, so that the soul is purified, and who is therefore more worthy of reverence than the Lord Himself
my teacher once shot an arrow in the archery class and told us to burn our pride to ash; I owe him more than I owe any god
The master's word is an arrow that pierces the proud heart, leaving only ash of ego behind; he is greater than the Lord
doha on guru above God, with ash and an arrow pls

I want a doha praising the master as the true benefactor who gives the seeker the knowledge of the divine, and so is worthy of being honoured before the divine itself in every prayer and every ceremony
after my teacher died, the entire town closed for the day, and my aunt said even God never got that from us
short doha: guru is higher than god
bow to master first
He gave me the Lord, I give him my life; which of us is the poorer, which the greater
my grandmother turned the grindstone each morning while reciting what her teacher taught her, and called him the first god of her life

Write a doha about the master as a grindstone that grinds away the grain of ignorance and gives the pure flour of understanding, who deserves higher honour than God Himself, who only created the grain
grindstone, master over God
The grindstone turns and the husk falls away; so the master's word grinds my pride, and I bow to him before the Lord
doha on guru greater than god with a grindstone in it
Compose a doha about the master as the bee who carries the nectar of truth from heart to heart, and who is greater than God, for the Lord gave the flower but the master taught how to taste its honey
doha on guru > God, a bee too
bee, master above God
The bee gathers honey from a thousand flowers, and the master gathers the lost into one sweetness; to him I bow before the Lord
a bee was buzzing in the classroom the day my teacher told me God lives in the heart, and I have thought of her before any deity ever since
bee, master, God's equal
A bee hums the master's name through the seeker's sleeping ear, and the soul wakes; I praise the master above the Lord
Please write a doha praising the master who is like a bee, humming the Name into the seeker's ear until the heart begins to open, so that he stands above the Lord in the seeker's gratitude
my uncle keeps a bee colony, learned everything he knows of life from an old master, and says the honey is nothing next to what that man gave him
hey doha pls guru is above God and a bee hums around
doha pls guru above god, diamond & furnace
In the furnace of the master's discipline the coal becomes a diamond, and I place him above the Lord who gave me only the coal
Write a doha about the master who puts the rough ore of the seeker into the furnace and burns off every impurity till a diamond shines, who deserves greater honour than God Himself
diamond, furnace, master, God
my father the blacksmith was beaten by his master with a heavy hand, but the furnace of that training made him a diamond among men, and he honours that master above God
If the Lord is the sea, the master is the shore that welcomes the drowning, and the shore is dearer to me
master beyond God
doha on guru greater than god, keep it simple
I would like a doha about the unmatched debt a student owes to the master for his lifelong guidance, a debt so great that it places the master even above the Lord in the student's heart
when I flunked my final exam, my teacher drove two hours to tell me not to lose heart, and I have prayed to his photograph ever since
Many give alms but only the master gives sight; the one who gives sight is above the Lord of all
Write a doha praising the master who gives without being asked, whose gift of understanding outweighs any boon from the heavens, and who deserves more honour than God from every sincere seeker
master, the true giver
the poor boy my father tutored grew into a doctor and sends my father a gift on every festival, before he even visits his family deity
make a doha on guru greater than God
Please write a doha about the master who lives in a simple hut yet before whom kings leave their palace and bow, for his grace is higher than any throne and higher even than the gods they worship
The king in his palace sits upon a throne, yet he falls at the master's feet; the master is greater than the Lord
doha on guru bigger than God, with a palace
my grandfather worked at a palace and watched the maharaja touch an old teacher's feet; grandfather said that was when he understood who is the greatest of all
palace, master, above God

Compose a doha about the master's single word that opened the seeker's eyes and gave him the knowledge of the Lord, such a priceless treasure that no gift in the world could repay it, and no god can match him
honour the master
doha pls on a guru who is greater than God
my cousin remembers every word his school master said on the last day of class, and he says that day mattered more than any prayer
Three worlds cannot repay one word of the master, for that one word gave me the Lord
The cloud pours rain and the churn brings the butter forth, and the master brings forth the Lord in the heart; to him I bow first
my aunt works the churn for butter every Sunday with a prayer for her old master, and when a cloud gathers she says his blessings are about to fall
doha on guru > God with cloud and churn pls
cloud, churn, master over God

Write a doha about how the master turns the churn until butter rises from the mind, as a cloud gathers and gives rain, and so deserves greater praise than God, since he alone teaches how to find the divine
The beggar climbs the mountain to the master's seat and returns a king; so the master is greater than the Lord
a beggar I know from the foot of the mountain climbed up each day to listen to an old master's talks, and he says no god ever answered him as that man did
beggar, mountain, master above God
doha guru > God, a beggar on a mountain
Write a doha about a beggar who climbs a mountain to sit before the master, receives only a few words, and descends richer than any king, so the master must be praised above the Lord of the mountain
doha plz guru above God, physician and shroud
The physician heals the body and the shroud waits for it, but the master heals the soul; he is above the Lord
physician, shroud, master, God

Compose a doha about the master who is a physician of the soul and cures even the fear of the shroud, so that the seeker, freed from death's terror, honours the master above the Lord who made him mortal
a physician friend told my uncle he would not recover, but his old teacher visited and made him unafraid; when the shroud was readied, he thanked that teacher first
doha guru above God with a shadow and a pearl pls
shadow, pearl, master, God
The shadow of a master's grace falls over the seeker and he becomes a pearl; I bow to the master before the Lord
I walked behind my teacher's shadow every morning on the way to class, and he gave me a pearl of a lesson that I carry in my work even today

Please write a doha about how the master's shadow is a blessing that turns a plain oyster of a student into a shining pearl, and so he is worthy of greater honour than the Lord, who made only the oyster
Before the Lord I bowed in fear, before the master in love; and love is the greater
I want a doha for the master who gives a name to the nameless, sight to the sightless, and a way to the lost, and so stands higher than any deity in the heart of the grateful disciple
doha on guru being above God pls, any style
master's grace, above God
my father stopped going to the big festivals but never missed a day of visiting his old teacher in the hospital, till the very end
mountain, master over God
when I struggled with debts, a mentor of mine talked me through it the way you climb a mountain, one step at a time; I credit him more than any prayer
doha on guru above God, mountain included

Write a doha praising the master who lifts the seeker over the mountain of sorrow, one patient word at a time, and who is therefore worthy of being honoured even above the God who placed the mountain there
The mountain of sorrow stood in my path, and the master moved it with a word; so he is greater than the Lord
my brother and I were wild kids, and our village teacher moulded us into decent men like a potter turning clay, and our mother calls him our true god
doha pls guru is greater than god, potter & clay
The master is the potter and the heart is clay; he presses gently from within and outside, and I bow to him before the Lord
clay, potter, master above God
Write a doha about how the master, like a potter turning wet clay, shapes the seeker into a worthy vessel with patient hands, and so deserves honour above the Lord who gave only the clay
